messages:
maya: quick status — trying to close out NYX-7b-lite onboarding before friday. TL;DR: model artifacts uploaded, manifest + licenses in S3, but two outstanding things: (1) perf profile for 2048 seq is missing, (2) a blocker on legal sign-off for redistributable weights. can owners chime in?

rahul: i'm owner for runtime/serving. perf job queued, ETA ~3h. i'll drop the perf snapshot to /s3/reports/nyx7b-lite/perf-489876 in csv+json. need to know which target latency/SLO to optimize for — p95 120ms or 180ms?

maya: thanks. aim for p95 < 150ms on ded-rtx6000 baseline. cost tier can be medium. if we can't hit that, we'll document fallback to quantized variant.

nina: legal here — i pulled the license file. it's Apache-2.0 + third-party blobs flagged. we need confirmation from the model provider on the extra blobs. can someone paste the manifest entry for blobs?

rahul: manifest snippet: ```
model: nyx-7b-lite
weights: s3://redwood-models/nyx/nyx-7b-lite/weights-v1.bin
blobs: [tokenizers.tar.gz, mmapped-embs.zip]
license: Apache-2.0
```

nina: ok that's helpful. please ping the provider and attach their contact email to the ingest issue. if we don't get a reply in 48h we treat blobs as non-redistributable and mark model as "hosted-only".

tess: curator note — eval suite ran but one regression in temperature sampling vs control (hallucination metric up 0.6%). linked eval: https://evals.redwood.internal/nyx7b-lite/run/489876. i'm adding a short prompt set to re-eval.

sam: code-review ping @rahul — i left comments on the runtime patch: CR-8912. main ask: add feature flag to disable KV cache sharing for this model (qa asked). small change but we should gate it behind rollout policy.

rahul: saw CR-8912, will address the KV flag. also will add a canary route 'nyx7b-lite-canary' and rollout % to 10% initially.

devbot: CI ✅ for ingest pipeline (build 482). perf job submitted: job-7722.

maya: ownership check — final signoff matrix: runtime: rahul, curation: tess, legal: nina, docs: sam. can everyone confirm?

tess: confirmed. i'll update the catalog entry with eval link and add "regression-note" tag.

nina: confirmed from legal side, pending provider reply for blobs. if they reply with redistributable license we'll flip the flag.

sam: confirmed for docs — will draft the model card and include deployment guidelines + SLO note. expecting to push docs PR by EOD.

rahul: confirmed. once perf job returns i'll attach results and open the runtime rollout PR.

maya: blockers summary: (A) provider blob clarification (legal) — nina owning follow-up, (B) perf snapshots posted (rahul) — in flight, (C) CR-8912 small changes (rahul/sam) — quick turnaround. if all green we'll schedule catalog publish for Mon morning.

maya: quick Q for planning — do we need a separate quantized variant entry in catalog now or add later as a compatible variant? thoughts?

tess: i'd prefer separate compatible variant entry with link to parent. keeps telemetry clean.

rahul: agree. runtime needs explicit variant mapping anyway for fallback routing. i'll add manifest field `compatible_variants: [nyx7b-lite-quant]`.

nina: one more legal note — if blobs remain non-redistributable, mark dataset provenance field accordingly and add a user-facing warning in model card.

maya: perfect. i'll monitor and reconvene async. tagging this as action items: nina follow provider, rahul attach perf + PR, sam docs PR, tess update catalog tags. ping here when each done :thumbsup:

rahul: perf job finished, uploaded CSV + JSON to s3, attaching summary:  p50 85ms, p95 142ms on rtx6000 with batch=8 and kv-cache enabled. looks within target.

maya: awesome, thanks rahul. rahul — can you paste the rollout snippet you plan to use?

rahul: rollout snippet: ```json
{"route": "nyx7b-lite", "variant": "nyx7b-lite-v1", "canary": 10, "fallback": "nyx7b-lite-quant"}```

sam: CR merged, docs PR open: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/4321. includes model card + warning template.

nina: provider replied, blobs are non-redistributable. legal marks as hosted-only. i've updated the ingest issue with email and final note.

tess: catalog updated, added compatible variant placeholder and regression note. final check: will we still publish on Mon but with hosted-only flag?

maya: yes — publish Monday with hosted-only flag and variant placeholder. thanks everyone, closing this thread.
